mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 10% in 1 month is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the combined condition is met and followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 2 consecutive months is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
